literal_meaning: বাপেরও বাপ আছে (even the father has a father)
figurative_meaning_bn: কেউ অজেয় নয়, তাকে শান্ত করার বা নিয়ন্ত্রণ করার লোক আছে
figurative_meaning_en: No one is invincible; there is always someone superior who can humble or control them
similar_in_english: The bigger they are, the harder they fall
Even the mightiest have their match
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে নিজেকে অজেয় মনে করে, কিন্তু বাপেরও বাপ আছে।
অহংকার করো না, মনে রেখো বাপেরও বাপ আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He thinks he's unbeatable, but remember, even the father has a father.
Don't be arrogant; no one is without a superior.
note: This idiom emphasizes the Bengali cultural value of recognizing social hierarchies and avoiding overconfidence.
